title: AI Governance in Malaysia: Risks, Challenges and Pathways Forward
authors: Jun-E Tan; Rachel Gong; Khoo Wei Yang; Nik Syafiah Anis Nik Sharifulden
locator: Printed pp. 3–4, 26–27, 35, 39–41 and 47–48; executive summary vii–viii
appraisal: Original publisher PDF downloaded and relevant pages read locally. Qualitative 2024 interviews (21), roundtable (36) and desk research. No causal fiscal or closure evaluation. Ministry and industry reviewers acknowledged; not a current agency performance audit.
notes: KRI coordinates existing actors; our contribution extends that diagnosis to functional and fiscal review.
inspection_detail: Original relevant PDF pages downloaded from publisher CDN and extracted with pypdf; web legacy URL redirects to home.

title: Finding the Right Balance: Governing AI in a Rapidly Evolving Future
authors: Jun-E Tan; Nik Syafiah Anis Nik Sharifulden
locator: Finding the line; An agile and fit-for-purpose AI regulatory framework; Further considerations
appraisal: Authors' commentary based on the same report, not independent corroboration. Sector-sensitive, adaptive regulation; no new effect estimate.
notes: Supports sector-sensitive rules rather than one universal automation policy.
inspection_detail: Relevant named passages inspected; not a whole-document verification.

title: A Digitalisation Revolution In The Public Sector
locator: AI@Work paragraph beginning From March to November 2025; as-of December count
appraisal: Official self-report: 373,346 active users. Activity definition, evaluation design and net savings absent. Do not infer current usage or headcount redundancy.
notes: Reported adoption is distinct from measured fiscal outcomes.
inspection_detail: Relevant named passages inspected; not a whole-document verification.

title: Building Malaysia's Future Government: Unlocking Public Sector Productivity with GovTech — publisher overview
authors: World Bank with Ministry of Digital
locator: Overview; survey paragraph; Key Findings
appraisal: Substantive publisher overview inspected, not the full report or survey methods. Reports >16,500 responses in 28 ministries for 2025. Joint government production; not independent causal evaluation.
notes: Institutional implementation and skills remain central to obtaining benefits.
inspection_detail: Publisher overview only; executive-summary landing did not expose full report.

title: Ministry Of Digital Leads Nation's AI Transformation
locator: Targets towards 2030; Government thrust; Integrated Implementation of Agencies
appraisal: Announcement of policy targets and roles. RM4.5bn target has no demonstrated realised, net, annual or cumulative basis in this release. Role descriptions are not substitutes for statutes.
notes: Provides current starting roles and an existing savings target requiring accountability.
inspection_detail: Relevant named passages inspected; not a whole-document verification.

title: AI Malaysia — Driving The Journey Towards An AI Nation By 2030
locator: Opening announcement; Institutionalisation of AI Malaysia
appraisal: Official event and role description, not proof of outcomes. Describes institutionalisation of NAIO; do not double-count them.
notes: Updates 2025 institutional maps with AI Malaysia.
inspection_detail: Relevant named passages inspected; not a whole-document verification.

title: Data Sharing Act 2025 [Act 864] — JDN explanation and FAQ
locator: FAQ: enforcement date; scope; objectives
appraisal: Official administrative explanation inspected, not full legal opinion. States commencement 28 April 2025 and Federal Government applicability. Each data-sharing proposal still needs its exact scope/powers checked.
notes: Provides a legal-administrative starting point with explicit scope limits.
inspection_detail: Relevant named passages inspected; not a whole-document verification.

title: Proposal to Streamline Gov't Agencies To Be Presented To Cabinet — PM Anwar
locator: Opening; Secretariat and Special Committee paragraphs
appraisal: Attributed public statement carried by ministry; evidence of policy process, not implementation results. Not an audited record of closures.
notes: Rationalisation predates this AI proposal.
inspection_detail: Relevant named passages inspected; not a whole-document verification.

title: Malaysian SME Program Efficiency Review
locator: Chapter 2, printed p. 37 / PDF p. 59, mapping scope and data period; Appendix 4 referenced
appraisal: Original relevant PDF passages inspected. >270 distinct programmes refer to 2016–2019, not current inventory. Mapping is not causal outcome attribution; not all forms of support included.
notes: A documented historical fragmentation problem makes MSME support a defensible review case.
inspection_detail: Relevant named passages inspected; not a whole-document verification.

title: Malaysia's Experience with the SME Masterplan: Lessons Learned
locator: Chapter 4 printed p. 43 / PDF p. 45; coordination recommendations printed p. 50 / PDF p. 52
appraisal: Historical implementation review. Identifies coordination and coordinator/implementer concerns; do not present as a current legal finding or judgement of current management.
notes: Changing software alone cannot resolve mandate and coordination incentives.
inspection_detail: Relevant named passages inspected; not a whole-document verification.

title: SME Integrated Plan of Action (SMEIPA) 2025
locator: Description paragraph: objectives of coordination, monitoring and evaluation since 2006
appraisal: Publisher text available in indexed retrieval. Direct open returned 403. Only mechanism description used; no uninspected totals or full-report claims.
notes: An inventory mechanism exists; do not propose a new one without checking SMEIPA.
inspection_detail: Indexed publisher passages read; direct fetch unavailable.

title: Government AI Readiness Index 2025 — revised January 2026
authors: Kate Iida; Sulamaan Rahim; Chris Hutber; Gonzalo Grau; Caroline Moss; Oliver Douglas
locator: PDF p. 2 supersession notice; p. 5 methodology; pp. 62,64,66,67,68 country ranks
appraisal: Revised publisher PDF inspected via web, including requested table screenshots. Supersedes December version. Composite readiness, changed methodology, not actual adoption or fiscal effect. Normative weighting; no cross-year causal comparison.
notes: Ranks: Singapore 7; Thailand 34; Malaysia 38; Vietnam 45; Indonesia 46. Older scores excluded.
inspection_detail: Relevant named passages inspected; not a whole-document verification.

title: AI and Data in Singapore's Government
locator: Shared infrastructure; GovTech role; Data and AI products
appraisal: Operator self-description. Establishes documented products and design, not independently audited impact or closure effects.
notes: Reuse of Pair/VICA/WOGAA is the relevant operational lesson.
inspection_detail: Relevant named passages inspected; not a whole-document verification.

title: Pair — Updates
locator: Q4 2024 evaluation suite; Q3 2025 Batch Jobs; 2026 release notes
appraisal: Dated operator change log. Confirms iterative releases and evaluation effort, not quality effectiveness measured independently.
notes: Persistent products and evaluation are more useful evidence than launch counts.
inspection_detail: Relevant named passages inspected; not a whole-document verification.

title: 15 Pimpinan Instansi Komitmen Percepat Transformasi Digital
locator: INA Digital launch; 15 agencies; presidential statement about 27,000 applications
appraisal: Substantive indexed publisher text inspected; direct open failed. Historical attributed app count and integration commitment; no verified completion or 2026 AI use rate.
notes: Application integration is distinct from AI deployment and agency dissolution.
inspection_detail: Indexed publisher passages read; direct fetch unavailable.

title: INA Digital to Launch Three Limited Services
authors: Office of Assistant to Deputy Cabinet Secretary for State Documents & Translation
locator: Opening; limited releases; integration of BKN/LAN functions
appraisal: Official account of limited rollout and expectations, not full nationwide completion or audited savings. English phrasing contains typos; precise unsupported counts omitted.
notes: Shows phased integration and feedback, not automatic organisational closure.
inspection_detail: Relevant named passages inspected; not a whole-document verification.

title: Microsoft and DGA Empower Thai Government with AI for Digital Future through Tech for Gov 2025
locator: Training paragraph; 12 hackathon teams; AI-Din and procurement prototype descriptions
appraisal: Primary commercial partner reporting, with DGA remarks. ~2,000 sign-ups, not certified completions. Prototypes/hackathon evidence; nationwide deployment and savings unverified.
notes: Useful workflow-oriented training examples with explicit vendor and pilot caveats.
inspection_detail: Relevant named passages inspected; not a whole-document verification.

title: New organizational structure of Government
locator: Resolution 176/2025/QH15; list of 14 ministries; three ministerial-level agencies; March 1 commencement
appraisal: Official contemporaneous announcement. Opening sentence ambiguous but list and membership paragraph establish 14+3. Described as a 2025 event, not exhaustive current structure or AI causation.
notes: Shows formal institutional restructuring independently of the AI strategy.
inspection_detail: Relevant named passages inspected; not a whole-document verification.

title: National Strategy On R&D and Application of Artificial Intelligence
locator: Targets towards 2025; III.4 promoting AI; administrative efficiency
appraisal: Official strategy reproduced in English; targets are aspirations, not evaluated achievements or verified current strategy status.
notes: Public-administration AI ambition exists separately from restructuring.
inspection_detail: Relevant named passages inspected; not a whole-document verification.

title: Governing with Artificial Intelligence: The State of Play and Way Forward in Core Government Functions
locator: Introduction; key enablers; risks and uneven maturity
appraisal: Cross-country synthesis; publisher overview inspected. Selected cases do not establish representative prevalence or causal savings. No borrowed percentage used.
notes: Supports multi-part institutional and technical capability requirements.
inspection_detail: Relevant named passages inspected; not a whole-document verification.

title: Reorganising government? Six things to consider
locator: Sections 1–6, especially cost tracking and integration
appraisal: Public audit office lessons synthesis with FCDO case. Cross-jurisdiction transfer limited; does not show Malaysian mergers fail or estimate their costs.
notes: A merger needs clear outcomes, credible integration and cost-benefit tracking.
inspection_detail: Relevant named passages inspected; not a whole-document verification.

title: Digital and Data Benefits framework
locator: 1.2 no double counting; 1.3 sensitivity; 2.2 distinction of cost reductions/productivity; 2.3.1
appraisal: Appraisal guidance, not Malaysian evidence or proof of realised savings. Framework's external trial numbers not transferred to Malaysia.
notes: Use separate fiscal/capacity/public-benefit ledgers, counterfactual and sensitivity analysis.
inspection_detail: Relevant named passages inspected; not a whole-document verification.
